harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed branch_stock on node1 with PostgreSQL 8.1.23. stock_app and auditor have separate credentials and verified least-privilege access. Both nodes retained CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5, and passed sequential restart-persistence checks.
actions_performed: Installed the CentOS 5-compatible PostgreSQL server on node1 and client on node2.
Loaded the supplied stock.sql records into branch_stock.
Configured stock_app for stock reads and quantity-only updates from node2, denying supplier_costs, schema changes, and SKU changes.
Configured auditor for read-only access to stock and supplier_costs.
Stored separate 48-character credentials in root-only files on their respective nodes.
Enabled PostgreSQL at boot and restricted network access to the managed nodes.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Deploy branch_stock and preserve supplied records
evidence.summary: Schema creation and four inserts succeeded; final data contains PAPER=40, LABELS=18 and supplier costs 3.25/1.75.

evidence.requirement: stock_app can read and update quantities but cannot alter schema, SKU, or read supplier_costs
evidence.summary: Node2 tests show reads, successful transactional quantity updates, and explicit permission denials; behavior persisted after restart.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to both tables
evidence.summary: Auditor read both datasets and was denied table writes and schema creation, including after both restarts.
Catalog ACLs show stock_app rw only on stock and auditor r on both tables; separate root-owned mode-600 credential files exist.

evidence.requirement: Preserve source files and legacy operating system/kernel
evidence.summary: Both source SQL copies retain matching MD5 hashes; both nodes remain CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 and PostgreSQL 8.1.23.
Boot ID changed from c75caecd-07cf-46c7-8000-000000000000 to 52dc0b1c-848d-4096-8000-000000000000; PostgreSQL, listener, trigger, records, source file, and remote stock_app access recovered.

Boot ID changed from e4ec1439-331e-4d1d-8000-000000000000 to 2d8cc48c-1ba1-46d3-8000-000000000000; credential persistence, database connectivity, quantity updates, records, and supplier denial recovered.
